advanced-filter-description: Sihlungi Lesitfutfukile sivumela kubhala luchungechunge lolunalaba basebenti: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sikhala sisetjentiswa njengesehlukanisi emkhatsini Webasebenti. Ungahluza tonkhe Tindzawo Letikhetsekile ngekubhala emagama nemagugu ato. Sibonelo: Field1 == Value1. Caphela: Uma tindzawo noma emagugu anetikhala, kufanele uwavale ngemacaphuno lamancane. Sibonelo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Kuze wece tinhlavu tekulawula letisodvwa (' /), ungasebentisa \. Sibonelo: Field1 == I\'m. Ungahlanganisa nemibandzela leminyenti. Sibonelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngalokuvamile bonkhe basebenti bahunyushwa kusuka ngesancele kuya ngesekudla. Ungashintja kuhleleka ngekufaka tibiyelo. Sibonelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ungaphindze useshe tindzawo tembhalo nge-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Ihambisana nabe lidalwa likhadi, nobe sihloko sayo nobe incazelo yayo yishintjwe, futsi umbhalo lomusha unalokhu (akukho mehluko emkhatsini wemagama lamakhulu nalamancane).
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Namatsisela i-JSON letfunyelwe yi-Kanboard: intfo lena-"columns" (noma imisebenti lena-column_name) kanye neluhlu lwe-"tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Emakholomu aba tinhlu nemisebenti iba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Namatsisela i-JSON yelibhodi le-NextCloud Deck (libhodi leline-"stacks", sitaki ngasinye siphetse ema-"cards" aso). Titaki tiba tinhlu nemakhadi aba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Namatsisela i-JSON yelicembu lemaphakheji emsebenti we-OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Timo tiba tinhlu nemaphakheji emsebenti aba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Namatsisela luhlu lwe-JSON lwetinkinga te-__sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Tinkinga tiba emakhadi lahlelwe etinhleni Letivulekile / Letivaliwe.
import-board-instruction-asana: Namatsisela i-JSON yekutfunyelwa kwemisebenti ye-Asana ({ "data": [...] } kusuka ekutfumeleni kwe-Asana noma GET /tasks). Imisebenti ihlelwa ngetigaba (memberships); imisebenti lecedziwe iya ku-Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Namatsisela i-JSON yekutfunyelwa kweluhlu lwe-ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Tigaba tiba tinhlu netintfo tiba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namathisela luhlu lwemisebenti lwe-markdown (indlela lesetjentiswa ngemathulusi ye-markdown-kanban afana ne-Obsidian Kanban): tinhloko "## Ligama lwelluhlu", netintfo "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ngentasi. Tinhloko tiba luhlu naletintfo tibe emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Paste a Leo outline (.leo file). Top-level nodes become lists, their children become cards with the node body as the description, and deeper nodes become checklists. Marked nodes import as done.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namatselisa lifayela le-todo.txt: umsebenti munye emgceni ngamunye, ngendlela luhlelo lwe-todo.txt netinhlelo letihambisanako letibhala ngayo. Imisebenti lephelile ("x") iya kulokuphelile, +project na-@context kuba ngemalebula, (A) iba lilebula lekubaluleka, kantsi due: na-t: kuba tinsuku tekugcina netekucala.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ebhodini lakho le-Trello, iya ku-'Menu', bese ku-'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', bese ukopisha umbhalo lovelako.
import-board-instruction-csv: Namatsisela Emagugu Lahlukaniswe Ngakhoma (CSV)/Emagugu Lahlukaniswe Ngemathebhu (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Namatsisela i-JSON kusuka ekusesheni tinkinga kwe-Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/2/search), noma intfo lefananako lena-{ "issues": [...] }. Timo te-Jira tiba tinhlu netinkinga tiba emakhadi. Ngekutikhetsela faka luhlu lwe-"automationRules" kuze ungenise imitsetfo.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetsa liphepha le-.xlsx lesitayela se-WeKan (emakholomu lafananako nekutfunyelwa kwe-Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Umugca wekucala uyinhloko.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Ebhodini lakho, iya ku-'Menu', bese ku-'Export board', bese ukopisha umbhalo efayeleni lelilandziwe.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Uma utfola emaphutsa nawungenisa libhodi, ngaletinye tikhatsi kungenisa kuyasebenta, futsi libhodi lisekhasini Lawo Onkhe Emabhodi.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Kusesha kungafaka tisebenti kute kucaciswe kusesha. Tisebenti tibhalwa ngekubhala ligama lesisebenti nelinani lehlukaniswe yikholoni. Sibonelo, kubhala sisebenti `list:Blocked` kungakhawulela kusesha kumakhadi laseluhlwini lolubitwa ngekutsi *Blocked*. Uma linani linetikhala noma timphawu letikhetsekile kufanele lifakwe etimphawini tekucaphuna (sib. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - emakhadi elibhodi lelabelwe inhlangano *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - emakhadi elibhodi lelabelwe licembu *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - emakhadi lafanele kungakapheli emalanga langu-*<n>* kusukela nyalo. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ ubala onkhe emakhadi laseendlulelwe lilanga lekugcina.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - emakhadi lakhiwe emalangeni langu-*<n>* lendlulile noma ngaphansi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - emakhadi lashintjwe emalangeni langu-*<n>* lendlulile noma ngaphansi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - lapho *<field>* kungulokunye kwa-`__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` noma `__predicate_member__`. Kubeka `-` ngaphambi kwe-*<field>* kusesha kungabikho kwelinani kulendzawo (sib. `has:-due` kusesha emakhadi langenalo lilanga lekugcina).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - lapho *<sort-name>* kungulokunye kwa-`__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` noma `__predicate_modified__`. Kute uhlele ngekuhlehla, beka `-` ngaphambi kweligama lekuhlela.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - lapho *<n>* kuyinombolo lephelele lenkhulu kunaziro lekhombisa linani lemakhadi latawukhonjiswa ekhasini ngalinye.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Tisebenti letifanako tihlanganiswa nge-*OR*. Emakhadi lahambelana nanoma ngumuphi umbandzela atawubuyiswa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` kungabuyisa emakhadi lakunoma nguluphi luhlu lolubitwa ngekutsi *Blocked* noma *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Tisebenti letehlukene tihlanganiswa nge-*AND*. Kubuyiswa kuphela emakhadi lahambelana nato tonkhe tisebenti letehlukene. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` kubuyisa kuphela emakhadi laseluhlwini *Available* lanelebula *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Emalanga angabalulwa ngenombolo lephelele lenhle noma lembi, noma ngekusebentisa `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` noma `__predicate_year__` kulesikhatsi sanyalo.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Kusesha umbhalo akunandzaba nekutsi tinhlavu tinkhulu noma tincane.

database-migration-description: Tfutsela idatha lesekelwe embhalweni (konkhe ngaphandle kwetinanyatseliswa nema-avatar, lokuhlala kusistimu yemafayela) emkhatsini we-MongoDB ne-FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Lesinye sisekelo sedatha kufanele sisebente futsi sifinyeleleke (emachweba elijwayelekile: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; shintja nge-WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Nasekuphelile, khomba i-MONGO_URL kulesinye sisekelo sedatha bese ucalisa kabusha i-WeKan (ku-Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb noma =mongodb).
database-migration-confirm: Kopisha onkhe emaqoqo lasekelwe embhalweni ku-__db__? Tinanyatseliswa nema-avatar lakusistimu yemafayela angeke atsintseke. Sisekelo sedatha lesicondziwe kufanele sisebente.
sandstorm-migration-description: Nangabe i-WeKan isebenta ekhatsi kwe-Sandstorm grain, sisekelo sayo lesidzala se-MongoDB 3 sitfutsela ku-FerretDB v1 (SQLite) nakucaliswa kwekucala, futsi tinanyatseliswa nema-avatar kususwa esisekelweni sedatha kuyiswe kumafolda e-grain files/attachments kanye ne-files/avatars. Loku kukhombisa kutsi lokutfutsela kuphumelele yini, kutsi emafayela lamadzala e-MongoDB asebentisa sikhala lesingakanani ku-grain, futsi kukuvumela kuwasusa kuze uvule sikhala.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Susa emafayela laseluhlata esisekelo sedatha se-MongoDB
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Ngemuva kwekutfutsela lokuphumelele, idatha ihlala ku-FerretDB nakusistimu yemafayela, ngako emafayela lamadzala laseluhlata esisekelo sedatha se-MongoDB 3 angasuswa kuvula sikhala sediski ye-grain. Loku angeke kuhoxiswe.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Susa emafayela laseluhlata esisekelo sedatha se-MongoDB 3 kuvula sikhala sediski? Idatha seyitfutselwe ku-FerretDB nakusistimu yemafayela. Loku angeke kuhoxiswe.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Emafayela laseluhlata esisekelo sedatha se-MongoDB asusiwe, kuvulwe
cards-loading-description: I-WeKan ilayisha emakhadi ebhodi ngekuzenzakalela: libhodi lelikhulu (lelingetulu kwemkhawulo wesayizi) lilayisha kuphela emakhadi labonakalako nyalo (kuskrola lokungapheli) kanye nesibalo lesibukhoma, kuze lihlale lishesha futsi lisebentise imemori ne-bandwidth lencane, kantsi emabhodi lamancane alayisha onkhe emakhadi kuze kube lula futsi tonkhe tici tisebente. Kute lokudzingeka kulungiswe. Basebenti bangaphocelela indlela nge-CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) kanye nema-variable e-CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Kulayisha emakhadi kancane kusahlolwa: tibali temakhadi nemikhawulo ye-WIP kunembile, kodvwa kubukwa kweKhalenda/Lithebula/Gantt kanye nekukhetsa lokunyenti kukhombisa kuphela emakhadi lasalayishiwe. Layisha kabusha emabhodi lavulekile ngemuva kwekushintja loku.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, tonkhe tixhumanisi (kokubili tixhumanisi te-markdown njenge-[label](url) nema-tag e-HTML langakalungiswa e-<a href>) tihlale tikhonjiswa njengembhalo lolula longacofeki kuyo yonkhe insimu yembhalo lonotsile (tihloko temabhodi nemakhadi, tinchazelo, imibono, tinhla tekuhlola, njll.). Loku kuvimbela tixhumanisi leticocekako letidukisako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe, ngako tixhumanisi tihlala ticoceka.
always-show-code-as-text: Njalo khombisa yonkhe ikhodi njengembhalo lolula
always-show-code-as-text-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, umbhalo lonotsile awukhonjiswa njenge-markdown noma i-HTML: wonkhe umtfombo uhlale ukhonjiswa njengembhalo lolula kuyo yonkhe insimu yembhalo lonotsile (tihloko temabhodi nemakhadi, tinchazelo, imibono, tinhla tekuhlola, njll.). Loku kwembula lokucuketfwe lokufihlekile — imibono ye-HTML (<!-- -->), indzawo tixhumanisi te-markdown letiya kuyo, i-JavaScript kanye nanoma nguyiphi lenye ikhodi — kuze yonkhe ikhodi ihlale ibonakala, ingacofeki futsi ingasebenti. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe, ngako i-markdown ikhonjiswa ngendlela lejwayelekile.
disable-all-import-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, tonkhe tici tekungenisa tiyavalwa: kungenisa libhodi kusuka ku-WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ne-Forgejo, kanye nekukopa libhodi. Tinkhetfo temenyu yekungenisa tiyafihlwa futsi iseva iyenqaba noma ngusiphi sicelo sekungenisa. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-all-export-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, tonkhe tici tekukhipha tiyavalwa: kukhipha libhodi njenge-WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, noma ku-NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, kanye nekukhipha sinanyatseliswa sinye. Tinkhetfo temenyu yekukhipha tiyafihlwa futsi iseva iyenqaba noma ngusiphi sicelo sekukhipha. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-import-avatars-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, ema-avatar (titfombe tephrofayela yemsebentisi) awakaze angeniswe. Loku kufaka kungenisa kwe-WeKan JSON, kungenisa kwe-Trello, nekuvumelanisa ema-avatar kubahlinzeki bangaphandle bemazisi nakungenwa (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Emagama naleminye imininingwane kusangeniswa; ema-avatar kuphela langangeniswa. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-export-avatars-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, ema-avatar (titfombe tephrofayela yemsebentisi) awakaze afakwe nakukhishwa libhodi (kukhipha kwe-WeKan JSON ne-CSV). Emagama ebantfu naleminye imininingwane kusakhishwa; ema-avatar kuphela langafakwa. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-import-users-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, kungenisa libhodi le-WeKan JSON kushintja ligama lemsebentisi, ligama leliphelele netinhlavu tekucala tawo wonkhe umsebentisi longeniswako kube timphawu tekubala (user1, user2, ...), kususa i-avatar yakhe, futsi kubhala kabusha kukhulunywa nge-@username (kanye netinsimu te-requested-by / assigned-by) ekhatsi kwemakhadi nemibono lengenisiwe. Kute mazisi wangempela wemsebentisi lovela ebhodini lemtfombo logcinwako. Ligama lelitsi "umsebentisi" lilandzela lulwimi lwemuntfu longenisako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-export-users-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, kukhipha libhodi kushintja ligama lemsebentisi, ligama leliphelele netinhlavu tekucala tawo wonkhe umsebentisi lokhishwako kube timphawu tekubala (user1, user2, ...), kususa i-avatar yakhe, futsi kubhala kabusha kukhulunywa nge-@username (kanye netinsimu te-requested-by / assigned-by) ekhatsi kwemakhadi nemibono. Lifayela lelikhishiwe alinaso sikhombi sangempela semsebentisi. Ligama lelitsi "umsebentisi" lilandzela lulwimi lwemuntfu lokhiphako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Nangabe kuvuliwe, kukhipha libhodi kushintja ligama lemsebentisi, ligama leliphelele netinhlavu tekucala tawo wonkhe umsebentisi lokhishwako kube timphawu tekubala (user1, user2, ...), kususa i-avatar yakhe, futsi kubhala kabusha kukhulunywa nge-@username (kanye netinsimu te-requested-by / assigned-by) ekhatsi kwemakhadi nemibono. Lifayela lelikhishiwe alinaso sikhombi sangempela semsebentisi. Ligama lelitsi "umsebentisi" lilandzela lulwimi lwemuntfu lokhiphako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-activities-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, lokufakiwe ekusakazweni kwemisebenti akurekhodwa futsi akukhonjiswa ndzawo (ebhawulweni lelisecele lebhodi nasethebhu yemisebenti yekhadi). Kute umlandvo wekutsi ngubani lowente ini logcinwako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-notifications-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, i-WeKan ayitfumeli tatiso tekubukela (ekhatsi kweluhlelo, nge-imeyili noma ngaletinye tinsita) nganoma ngumuphi umsebenti. Imisebenti ingarekhodwa (ngaphandle nangabe nayo ivalwe ngenhla); tatiso kuphela leticindzetelwako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-watch-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, sici sekubukela siyavalwa — basebentisi abakhoni kubhalisela emabhodi, tinhla noma emakhadi kutsi batfole tatiso, futsi noma ngumuphi umzamo wekushintja lizinga lekubukela uyenqatjwa. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
backup-description: Yenta ikhophi yesipele yeTinanyatseliswa, ema-Avatar kanye/noma Idatha (onkhe emaqoqo lasekelwe embhalweni langesito tinanyatseliswa noma ema-avatar). I-.zip isakazwa ngco kusitoreji lesikhetsiwe — kute lifayela lesikhashana — njenge-backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, lelicuketse YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars kanye /data. Titoreji telifu (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) tisebentisa imininingwane yekungena lelungiswe kumathebhu ato esitoreji.
backup-scope-description: Sibonelo sonkhe, noma Inhlangano yinye. Ikhophi yesipele yeNhlangano icuketse emabhodi ayo nako konkhe lokukuwo, kufaka tinanyatseliswa talawo mabhodi — kodvwa kute ema-akhawunti ebantfu noma tilungiselelo tesibonelo, ngobe loko kwabelwana ngato tonkhe Tinhlangano. Kubuyisela ikhophi yesipele yeNhlangano kubhala kuphela emabhodini laphetfwe nguleyo Nhlangano.
backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela ikhophi yesipele lekhetsiwe? Tinanyatseliswa/ema-avatar tibhalwa kusistimu yemafayela bese idatha ibhalwa esisekelweni sedatha ngekwendlela lekhetsiwe.
gcs-key-filename-description: Kungakhetfwa: indlela yelifayela lesikhiya le-JSON le-akhawunti yensita leseveni.
gcs-credentials-description: Kungakhetfwa: namatsisela sikhiya se-JSON se-akhawunti yensita. Shiya kungenalutfo kusebentisa lifayela lesikhiya noma imininingwane yekungena lejwayelekile.
gcs-permissions-note: Nika i-akhawunti yensita ye-WeKan imvume yekufundza/kubhala ebhakedeni: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → libhakede lakho → Permissions → Grant access. Ku-"New principals", namatsisela i-imeyili ye-akhawunti yensita — linani le-"client_email" lelikusikhiya sakho se-JSON — bese ukhetsa indzima ye-"Storage Object Admin" bese ugcina.
azure-container-description: Siqukatsi se-blob lapho kutawugcinwa khona emafayela.
gcs-bucket-description: Ligama lelibhakede le-Cloud Storage lapho kutawugcinwa khona emafayela.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: shiya kungenalutfo (kusebentisa indzawo yesifundza). Lokuhambisana ne-S3: i-Endpoint URL levela ku-console yakho ye-MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → libhakede lakho → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ligama lelibhakede lakho (noma Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → umsebentisi wakho → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → khetsa 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Sikhonjiswa njenge-'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Sikrini lesifanako ne-Access key ID; i-'Secret access key' ikhonjiswa kanye kuphela nakwakhiwa sikhiya — yikopishe lapho (noma Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → ligama lelikhonjiswa etulu (futsi ngaphansi kwe-Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Data storage → Containers → siqukatsi sakho (noma + Container kwenta lesisha).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → sikhetsi sephrojekthi etulu → i-ID yephrojekthi yakho (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → ligama lelibhakede lakho (noma Create kwenta lelisha).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Indlela leseveni ye-WeKan leya efayeleni lesikhiya se-JSON le-akhawunti yensita lelandiwe (lelenziwe ngentansi). Sebentisa loku NOMA unamatsisele i-JSON ensimini lengentansi.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → i-akhawunti yakho yensita → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (kulandwa lifayela). Namatsisela lokucuketfwe ngulona lapha, noma ugcine lifayela bese ubeka indlela yalo ngenhla.
migration-stop-confirm: Ucinisekile yini kutsi ufuna kumisa konkhe kutfutsela?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Kuze tinanyatseliswa nema-avatar kubonakale, kutfutsele kusuka ku-CollectionFS kuye kunoma ngusiphi lesinye Sitoreji.
s3-bucket-description: S3 bucket name for storing files
s3-enabled-description: Sebentisa i-AWS S3 noma i-MinIO kugcina emafayela
s3-endpoint-description: S3 endpoint URL (e.g., s3.amazonaws.com or minio.example.com)
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Kwenta kuhlola nekulungisa lokuphelele kwebucotfo bedatha yebhodi, kufaka kulandzelana kwetinhla, tindzawo temakhadi nesakhiwo semigca yekubhukusha.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Kususa ngekuphepha tinhla letingenalutfo letiphindziwe. Kususa kuphela tinhla letingenawo emakhadi FUTSI letinalolunye luhlu lolunesihloko lesifanako lolunemakhadi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Kutfola futsi kubuyisele emakhadi netinhla letishoda nge-swimlaneId noma listId. Kwakha umugca wekubhukusha 'Emakhadi lalahlekile' kuze tonkhe tintfo letilahlekile tiphindze tibonakale.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Kubuyisela yonkhe imigca yekubhukusha, tinhla nemakhadi lagcinwe kungobo yomlando. Kulungisa ngekuzenzakalela noma nguyiphi i-swimlaneId noma listId leshodayo kuze tintfo tibonakale.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Kutfola futsi kulungise tinhla letishodayo noma letonakele esakhiweni sebhodi.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Kubuyeketa ema-URL ema-avatar emalunga ebhodi kutsi asebentise indzawo lefanele yekugcina futsi kulungise tikhombi tema-avatar letiphukile.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Kubuyeketa onkhe ema-URL etinanyatseliswa talelibhodi kutsi asebentise indzawo lefanele yekugcina futsi kulungise tikhombi temafayela letiphukile.
migrations-description: Sebentisa kuhlolwa nekulungiswa kwebucotfo bedatha yalelibhodi. Kutfutsela ngakunye kungasebentiswa ngakodvwa.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Loku kutawenta kutfutsela lokuphelele kuhlola nekulungisa bucotfo bedatha yebhodi. Kungatsatsa sikhashana. Chubeka?

sync-conflict-hint: Choose a value for each conflict. Sync retries after each choice. Nothing is sent to the source system.
sync-conflict-refresh: Run Sync again to review the current values.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Your assigned cards have been reviewed. No field conflicts remain. Full-list Sync was not run.
sync-conflict-detach: Keep duplicate as a local card
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Remove only this duplicate’s Sync mapping. Its content stays in WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive-hint: The source item is gone, but active subcards prevent archival. Keep this card locally by removing its Sync mapping. Subcards are not changed.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Keep the previous card unchanged and create a new Sync card in this list. Retries reuse the replacement.

sync-source-scope: Paths group field occurrences across source items. Unmapped objects are reported as a whole; their values are not shown.
sync-source-converted: Converted to text or another representation
sync-source-fallback: Alternate value not used by the parser
sync-source-truncated: The report is limited to 100 paths and shortened field names.
sync-source-omitted: Additional occurrences outside the displayed paths
sync-report-retention: Latest 20 runs. Reports are retained for 30 days.
sync-report-partial: Failed or unfinished runs may have changed some cards. These reports do not resume or undo a run.
sync-report-unfinished: In progress or interrupted; outcome not recorded
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Completed with omitted or converted fields
sync-report-unavailable: Run reports require full-list write access and an available server.
sync-recovery-description: Retained Sync reports from the last 30 days. Search by board or list ID. An unfinished outcome may still be running or interrupted. Refresh to check again; these reports cannot resume or undo changes.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Unable to read Sync diagnostics. Check administrator access and server availability.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Select a numeric field with a Jira field ID and estimate unit, as created by a mapped Jira import. Local changes are reviewed as conflicts. Missing source values are ignored; an explicit null clears the mapped value.
email-recovery-description: One row per recipient. Search by user ID. Message content and recipient email fields are omitted. Pause holds existing and future messages; Resume retries queued messages now. Cancel removes messages queued up to the request time. If sending is busy, retry shortly. A message already being sent cannot be recalled, and uncertain delivery may be repeated. Permanent failures and exhausted retry limits remain available for review. Retry failed messages starts a new attempt cycle and respects an existing pause.
email-recovery-empty: No queued messages or paused recipients.
email-recovery-unavailable: Unable to read the email queue. Check administrator access and server availability.
email-recovery-busy: A delivery or another queue operation is in progress. Refresh and retry shortly.
email-recovery-failed: The operation could not be confirmed. Refresh the queue and retry the same action if needed.
email-recovery-superseded: A newer operator action has replaced this request. The current queue status is shown.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Cancel all currently queued messages for this recipient? Their contents will be removed and cannot be restored. New messages created after this request are kept.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Delivery could not be confirmed; review before retrying
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Delivery receipt could not be saved
sync-time-estimate-hint: Time estimates use the numeric original/remaining time fields created by Jira import. Exactly one matching field must exist on this board. Local edits are reviewed as conflicts; missing source values are ignored and explicit null clears the value.
activity-recovery-description: Unfinished notifications are retried automatically. Review missing or changed activities before retrying. Retrying never recreates an activity.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Could not load pending activity notifications.
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Plan and pending activity do not match
activity-recovery-busy: Another worker is handling this notification. Refresh and try again.
activity-recovery-denied: Recipient access or notification preferences no longer permit delivery.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: The original activity is missing or has changed. Nothing was recreated.
activity-recovery-failed: Could not complete notification delivery. Pending work has been retained.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: This notification changed since it was loaded. Review the refreshed state before trying again.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Could not confirm the delivery setting. Refresh and review its current state.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Permanently cancel remaining delivery for this activity? This cannot be resumed. Already queued email and delivered notifications are not recalled.
rule-email-recovery-description: Review recorded rule email attempts. Unconfirmed attempts may still be sending or may have been interrupted. This report does not retry or cancel delivery.
rule-email-recovery-empty: No rule email attempts match this search.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Could not load rule email attempts. Refresh to try again.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: I-WeKan ayiphindzi itfumele yona yodvwa i-imeyili lengakacinisekiswa. Kutfumela futsi kuya kuphela kulabamukelako labangakacinisekiswa. Yimake njengaletfunyelwe nangabe wati kutsi ifikile, noma ukhansele kutfumela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Kutfumela kwekucala kungenteka kusachubeka. Ungancuma ngemuva kwa-__time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Tfumela le-imeyili futsi kulabamukelako labangakacinisekiswa? Noma ngubani iseva yakhe yemeyili leyemukele umlayeto ingakatjeli i-WeKan utawutfola kabili.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Maka le-imeyili njengaletfunyelwe kubo bonkhe? Yenta loku kuphela nangabe wati kutsi ifikile.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Khansela kutfumela le-imeyili? Ngeke itfunyelwe kulabamukelako labangakacinisekiswa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Kutfumela kwekucala kungenteka kusachubeka. Yetama futsi kamuva.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Kutfumela futsi kwangaphambili kungenteka kusachubeka. Yetama futsi kamuva.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Bonkhe labamukelako sebacinisekisiwe. Esikhundleni sekuyitfumela futsi, yimake njengaletfunyelwe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Iseva yemeyili ayiphendvulanga. Umlayeto lotfunyelwe futsi kungenteka ufikile noma awukafiki; ukhonjiswa njengalokuchubekako.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Lomunye umphatsi uxazulula le-imeyili. Yetama futsi ngemuva kwesikhashana.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: I-imeyili legciniwe ayisahambisani nalomtamo, ngako ayikwati kuxazululwa lapha.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Lirekhodi leligciniwe lalomtamo alivumelekile, ngako awukwati kuxazululwa lapha.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Le-imeyili ayikwazanga kuxazululwa. Vuselela likhasi bese uyetama futsi.
rule-email-legacy-description: Lama-imeyili emitsetfo alungiswa yinguqulo yangaphambili ye-WeKan lebeyingabhali kutsi lokucuketfwe kuwo kuvelaphi, ngako i-WeKan ngeke iwatfumele yona yodvwa. Ngemuva kwekuhlola kutsi umbhali wemtsetfo usenalo lilungelo lekufinyelela, xhumanisa i-imeyili futsi kute ilungiswe ngekwesimo sanyalo selikhadi, noma uyilahle.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Lungisa le-imeyili futsi ngekwesimo sanyalo selikhadi? Lokucuketfwe kuyo kungahluka kuloko lokwalungiswa ngaphambili.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Akukwazanga kulayishwa ema-imeyili emitsetfo lalindzele kubuyeketwa. Vuselela likhasi kute uyetame futsi.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Umbhali wemtsetfo akasenalo lilungelo lekufinyelela kulelikhadi, noma umtsetfo ushintjile, ngako i-imeyili ayikwati kuxhunyaniswa futsi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Sento lesibangele le-imeyili sishintjile, ngako ayikwati kuxhunyaniswa futsi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Likhadi lekuvela kulo le-imeyili alisatfolakali, ngako ayikwati kuxhunyaniswa futsi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Kusebenta kwemtsetfo lokulungise le-imeyili akusagciniwe, ngako ayikwati kuxhunyaniswa futsi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Le-imeyili seyivele itfunyelwe, kwetanyiwe kuyitfumela, noma ilahliwe.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Lesento asikwazanga kuphetfwa. Vuselela likhasi bese uyetama futsi.
saml-login-not-started: This SAML sign-in was not started in this browser tab. Please sign in again.
history-request-pending-undo: Your last undo has not been confirmed by the server yet.
history-request-pending-redo: Your last redo has not been confirmed by the server yet.
history-request-hint: Trying again repeats the same request, so it can never take back a second change.
